- No mandatory facet token is uncovered.

- Every requirement ID and section alias is claimed by at least one case.

## Design status

- Total cases: 383. Every case is `NOT_RUN`: the specifications exist, the system under test does not.
- Gaps above are documented rather than hidden. They are not evidence of coverage and not a claim that the checklist surface is exhaustively covered.
